verdict.rationale: Clipping a highlight or soundbite from a call is a fair question for a meeting-recording and notetaker product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents sharing whole notes via link or team folders, CSV export of transcripts, and a magnifying glass that traces a note back to its transcript source. None of this is a clip or soundbite feature, and nothing shows the ability to cut and share a specific moment.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
